column1: # Well-known company, product and model names, for every language (detect/ner_orgs.py, LAB-1336).
# One name per line, as it is written; matching ignores case. An NER PERSON span that is
# exactly one of these (plus an inflection suffix) becomes ORGANIZATION, which policy keeps.
# Leave out names that are also common given names or surnames (Ford, Dell, Tesla, Siemens,
# Porsche, Disney, Claude, Alexa, Siri ...): a missed brand is an over-mask, a missed person a
# leak. A name that a pack's name lexicon lists is never relabelled anyway.
